trajectory.patch:
The build is failing due to compilation errors caused by Kconfig options being disabled. The Kconfig option `CONFIG_FCB_ALLOW_FIXED_ENDMARKER` is disabled because its dependency `CONFIG_FCB` is disabled, which in turn is disabled because `CONFIG_FLASH_MAP` is not available in the current build configuration (likely due to `CONFIG_NATIVE_LIBRARY` being enabled).

The compilation errors arise because some source files are not correctly handling the case where `CONFIG_FCB_ALLOW_FIXED_ENDMARKER` is disabled.

1.  `tests/subsys/fs/fcb/CMakeLists.txt` has a bug where it fails to remove `src/fcb_test_crc_disabled_after_enabled.c` from the build when `CONFIG_FCB_ALLOW_FIXED_ENDMARKER` is disabled. The `list(REMOVE_ITEM ...)` command is missing the list variable `app_sources`.
2.  `tests/subsys/fs/fcb/src/fcb_test_append.c` contains a test case that uses a variable (`test_fcb_crc_disabled`) which is only defined when `CONFIG_FCB_ALLOW_FIXED_ENDMARKER` is enabled. The test case itself needs to be conditionally compiled.

The following fixes address these issues.

tests/subsys/fs/fcb/CMakeLists.txt
<<<<<<<< SEARCH
if(NOT CONFIG_FCB_ALLOW_FIXED_ENDMARKER)
  list(REMOVE_ITEM "src/fcb_test_crc_disabled_after_enabled.c")
endif()
========
if(NOT CONFIG_FCB_ALLOW_FIXED_ENDMARKER)
  list(REMOVE_ITEM app_sources "src/fcb_test_crc_disabled_after_enabled.c")
endif()
>>>>>>>> REPLACE
tests/subsys/fs/fcb/src/fcb_test_append.c
<<<<<<<< SEARCH
ZTEST(fcb_test_crc_disabled, test_fcb_append_crc_disabled)
{
	test_fcb_append(&test_fcb_crc_disabled);
}
========
#if defined(CONFIG_FCB_ALLOW_FIXED_ENDMARKER)
ZTEST(fcb_test_crc_disabled, test_fcb_append_crc_disabled)
{
	test_fcb_append(&test_fcb_crc_disabled);
}
#endif
>>>>>>>> REPLACE
